validation: all three are finite numbers greater than zero; HTML suggested ranges are not extra business caps
scope: device/global preferences; explicit selected account for holdings, actual configured watchlist and manual leader roster for other signals; not per-account limits or stop prices
persistence: dedicated UTF-8 JSON preference file; per-file lock and atomic replace; full-record baseline CAS; missing file reads revision0/defaults without writing preference data; corrupt/future record rejects without reset

consumer.dailyDrop: position todayChange and non-held watchlist change <= -dailyDrop; position high at <= -1.6*dailyDrop
consumer.dailyRise: same dailyDrop magnitude also controls >= +dailyDrop positive signals
consumer.leaderDrop: explicit-identity manual leader change <= -leaderDrop; high at <= -1.6*leaderDrop
consumer.ordering: native source/rule order; explicit severity; no claim to reproduce the legacy 0-or-9 high-rank sorting bug

nativeAdapter.positionMetric: existing native moving-average ledger averageCost * quantity gives unrounded cost; price * quantity gives value; audited legacy estimated exit fee/tax constants are both zero; JS-style round((value-cost)/cost*100,2); exclude closed quantities
nativeAdapter.boundary: floating P/L over cost, not historical peak drawdown, performance return or forecast; no edits to existing ledger/calculation modules
nativeAdapter.identity: full instrument IDs, account IDs and manual sector/member IDs; no bare-code quote guessing for unresolved leaders; held-watch daily dedup uses full ID
nativeAdapter.unknown: null/missing/nonfinite/unavailable stays unknown, no fabricated zero; stale numeric predicates retain old behavior with source/time/stale label

imports: explicit webstock_risk_settings object or original JSON string
raw old object with at least one actual threshold field
importPolicy: preview full original, normalized values and per-field fallback warnings; explicit browser key may be empty and use disclosed defaults; unrelated server table backup rejected; confirmation uses captured full baseline; cancel no preference write; unsaved editor and baseline preserved if import changes active values
draftPolicy: atomic private sidecar preserves baseline, three strings, selected account, filter and pending preview; Bundle/QJsonObject holds file marker only; theme/filter/scope do not save business preferences; unreadable state blocks automatic overwrite until explicit discard/reload
sourceAction: fresh saved-threshold evaluation must still contain the exact selected alert including account, source row, metric, threshold and severity; local unsaved draft blocks external navigation; root verifies full ID/name and protects target draft
back: internal detail/preview reader to settings retaining draft and pending import returns true; otherwise false; no browser history
verificationBoundary: independent Qt/JVM/SDK and actual legacy-source reference checks; root owns shared host/build and 5564 emulator acceptance; no ARM-device acceptance inferred
